card.name: Large quantities after comparison words
card.fires_on: The spot just before or at a big number, often millions, after words like "more than", "just over", "approximately" or "larger than". Seen in general web text on population, poverty, area or emissions.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space or small word right before a large figure given in millions.
modes.example: South Asia is home to the largest population suffering from extreme poverty as measured by the new Multidimensional Poverty Index:<< >>844 million people.
